name: test_sent_contract_shows_signer_status_and_lifecycle_controls
description:
Objective: Sent contract shows signer status and lifecycle controls.
Preconditions: Open Contract workflow with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Contract workflow.
2. Sent contract shows signer status and lifecycle controls.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The expected records, controls, or page state are displayed.
